title: DB-273 (M5-T203): one street-window fetch when the live spatial provider is on: the geometry provider and the street-data provider share one fetch of the same street window (flag off by default; no live behaviour changes)
objective: Read first: services/api/app/api/v1/study_live_geometry.py (live_geometry_provider fetches the street window through fetch_streets) and services/api/app/api/v1/study_inputs.py (live_street_data_provider, ~line 577, fetches the same window again), and the route that calls both. Make the two share ONE fetch of the same street window per request (for example a per-request memo keyed by the canonical BBL and the window, or passing the first result through), behind LIVE_SPATIAL_PROVIDER_ENABLED exactly as today; the flag-off path and every injected test double are byte-identical. New test file: the window is fetched once with the flag on (counting fake fetch), the merged results equal the two-fetch results, a fetch failure surfaces exactly as before in both providers, and the flag-off path performs no fetch. If the fix needs a file outside the allowed paths, STOP and report the file and why.
business_reason: DB-273: with the live spatial provider switched on, the same street window is fetched twice per request; the flag is off by default, so this is a latent cost and consistency risk fixed before any production switch.
